about_the_game:
The Improvised Tactics Demo currently features all content, when the full game releases expect the removal of some content from the demo.



Improvised Tactics is a single player game where you lead a small army to victory!

There are several features that let you control your army. You can tell your units where to go or play as them for a boots on the ground experience. Improvised Tactics will offer three game modes.

Conquest Mode:

In Conquest Mode you are fighting a resource war in a grid based world map. You can customize your soldiers and squads. You may also invade enemy territory to get stronger although beware you can be invaded as well.

In the overview map you must build infrastructure to support and raise your army! Using your resources you can build an economy to buy weapons and equipment.

Sandbox Mode:

In Sandbox Mode you are able to use the customization features of Conquest Mode in a free setting. The sandbox maps are designed to put your custom units against enemies in arenas.

Scenario Mode:
In Scenario Mode you are given objectives that you must complete. You are given money that you can use to buy units to help complete your job. Some scenarios involve you defending against enemy waves, in other scenarios you are on the offensive and you must destroy enemy objectives.

content_descriptors.notes: Improvised Tactics gameplay focuses on warfare. expect guns and blood.
